representation: Three-owner summary of the independently reviewed source/fidelity findings as quoted in the actual Root merits receipt. This is not a copy of either full research packet; the two excluded Collect English texts and complete modern comparison texts are omitted.

rows.decision: Accept the complete historical source and new English fidelity unchanged. Recommend a qualified priority-6 basis for this one finite study-English preparation, with moderate confidence. This receipt does not admit modern Latin or activate a canonical body.
rows.whole_expression_basis: The complete independently old prayer already supplies the continuous expressive construction: perpetual divine favor toward the Church, transformation through the paschal mysteries, and movement toward resurrection radiance. The same invocation, object, subordinate purpose structure, instrumental mysteries, terminal destination and sequence remain in the compared prayer. The two revised verbs are conventional alternatives within that existing sentence rather than an added petition, a rearrangement of separately selected sources, or a newly developed narrative. The complete ending is also independently old and conventional. Evaluating this exact whole together, a qualified conclusion that the added contribution remains routine adaptation is defensible under the repository priority-6 presumption.
rows.strongest_contrary: These are the operative petition verb and the participial premise of the purpose clause, not incidental words. A coordinated choice to request protection and describe renewal can change the prayer’s theological emphasis and cadence even while the surrounding syntax is retained. The change from raised or revived to renewed has particular force in an Easter prayer. Such deliberate literary redaction may supply original expression in a revised whole. Common individual words and extensive overlap do not decide that issue, and the historical foundation does not automatically remove rights in a modern contribution.
fidelity: God preserves the vocative, always preserves Perpetuo, and guard translates the revised tuere rather than restoring the older prosequere.

Your Church with your loving favor preserves the object, possessive relation and gracious divine favor. The second your is naturally supplied from the God-addressed construction and introduces no new agent.

So that, renewed through the paschal mysteries preserves the purpose clause, passive renovata and instrumental paschal mysteries. Renewed correctly follows the revised reading and does not import raised from the older participle.

She may reach the radiance of the resurrection preserves the Church as the singular subject, perveniat and the resurrection genitive. Radiance conveys claritatem in this setting without turning it into mere intellectual clarity.
Through Christ our Lord renders the complete separately old formula. R. Amen remains explicitly marked as the distinct response.

rows.whole_expression_basis: The entire 1922 prayer already supplies the same address, divine compassion, sacramental presence, new peoples born from the font, adoption, humble human ministry and divine accomplishment, in that order. The 2014 body contracts the two immediately repeated presence invocations to one. The modifier for great compassion consequently attaches directly to sacraments, but the invocation and its referent were already linked by the old parallel clauses. The shortening does not compose a different operative request or select and rearrange independent prayers. The exact old standard short ending changes the conclusion, independently controlled by the actual 2014 full printing. Evaluating those changes together, this is a defensible finite adaptation of the complete old prayer under policy section 1 basis 6. This is not a finding that every omission is unoriginal or that the modern Latin is word-for-word old.
rows.strongest_contrary: Contracting parallel invocations is an editorial choice, and the new full body combines the shortened invocation with a different length of conclusion. Abridgments can carry original authorship even without newly coined words. Here the immediate repetition is contracted without altering the series or interrelation of the operative petitions, and the independently old conclusion is specifically printed for this occasion; those concrete features support the bounded basis despite the editorial-choice objection.
rows.fidelity: All clauses and relationships are retained: recreate is regenerative new birth; peoples remains plural; the font bears them for God; adoption is sent forth; humble ministry remains distinct from divine power and its effect. Be present to is literal but intelligible. The conclusion and distinct response are complete. No correction requested.

rows.whole_expression_basis: The complete first 1862 fire prayer supplies the whole ordered expression: God gives the faithful the fire of divine radiance through the Son; sanctifies this new fire; kindles heavenly desire through the paschal feasts; brings pure minds to the everlasting feasts of radiance. The 2014 prayer removes the explanatory cornerstone apposition and the fire-source/use modifiers; it retains each governing request, actor, object, purpose and their order. The old same-Christ qualifier is removed in favor of a separately old complete standard short formula that is actually printed in 2014. Taken together these bounded elisions simplify the complete existing prayer without composing a different request or assembling pieces from the other two old fire prayers. The unchanged interconnected petitions provide a defensible basis 6 for this exact study adaptation; the finding is deliberately qualified rather than an assertion of exact old identity.
rows.strongest_contrary: Removing cornerstone and flint removes a deliberate Christological and material correspondence. An editor could claim authorship in the resulting selective abridgment; merely observing that no new words were added would be inadequate. The retained radiance/fire/desire/feast progression and every operative petition already form a single complete 1862 unit in the same order. The removed clauses explain the Son and fire already named rather than supplying a new structural arrangement after deletion. This supports an ambiguous but defensible finite publication decision, not a universal exemption for deletions.
rows.fidelity: Radiance consistently renders claritas; faithful recipients, this fire, sanctification, heavenly desires, paschal feasts, pure minds and final feasts all survive. So...that preserves the relation between the desire and arrival petitions. The removed cornerstone, flint and practical use are not smuggled into English. Full short conclusion and separately marked response are present. No correction requested.
